title: Street Resurface Program
description: Use this service request to inquire about a street resurfacing (asphalt) project that is currently under construction and being performed by the city. The estimated response time (ERT) for this service request is 3 business days.

observedQuestions.prompt: Are you asking to have the street resurfaced for the first time?

branches.Yes: Validation Alert: first time requests should use Street Repair (Routine)

observedQuestions.prompt: Is your concern related to lane striping or missing markings because of construction?
Where is the construction project located (address/street block)?
Would you like to be contacted?
options: Yes - prior to work being completed
Yes - once the work is completed

detailsForm.completedContactPath: First time = No; lane striping concern = No; construction ongoing = Yes

actions.tagline: Submit a 311 request about an ongoing City street-resurfacing project.
actions.why: For an inquiry about a City of Dallas asphalt street-resurfacing project currently under construction. The 311 request form asks whether this is a first-time resurfacing request, whether lane markings are affected, whether construction is ongoing, who is doing the work, and the location.
actions.why_not: The online form for "Street Resurface Program" requests does not describe a first-time request to resurface a street or work that is no longer underway. The 311 request form suggests "Street Repair (Routine)" for those answers.
actions.how: Go to Dallas 311 > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Street Resurface Program"
actions.how_formatted: [Go to Dallas 311](https://dallascrm.my.site.com/public/s/) > Choose "Streets, Medians, Sidewalks and Alleys" > Choose "Street Resurface Program"
